title: Verb てもらいたい (～te moraitai)
shortExplanation: Express a desire to receive a favor or service from someone else.
longExplanation: The ～てもらいたい grammar point is used to express one's desire to receive a favor, service, or action from someone else. It is formed by attaching もらいたい to the て-form of verbs. This structure emphasizes the help or favor the speaker wants from someone else.

examples.jp: この荷物を運んでもらいたいです。
examples.romaji: Kono nimotsu o hakonde moraitai desu.
examples.en: I want you to carry this luggage for me.

examples.jp: 彼にそのニュースを教えてもらいたい。
examples.romaji: Kare ni sono nyuusu o oshiete moraitai.
examples.en: I want him to tell me the news.

examples.jp: 友達に日本語を教えてもらいたい。
examples.romaji: Tomodachi ni Nihongo o oshiete moraitai.
examples.en: I want my friend to teach me Japanese.

examples.jp: スタッフにチェックインの方法を説明してもらいたい。
examples.romaji: Sutaffu ni chekkuin no houhou o setsumei shite moraitai.
examples.en: I want the staff to explain the check-in process to me.

usageNote: Neutral "I'd like you to..." - less formal than ていただきたい.
